"Jamie & Jimmy's Food Fight Club" is based out of a UK cafe in Southend, Essex. Jamie Oliver and Jimmy Doherty are childhood friends and own the cafe together and they each have their own unique set of skills. Jamie cooks up delectable weekend dishes while Jimmy heads outdoors to seek out wild ingredients for his feasts. The two friends are joined by celebrity guests such as Michael Sheen, Kate Hu
